start.title: Among His People
start.text:
You walk where Hebrews labor.
A taskmaster strikes a slave hard.

walk_away_consequence.title: The Cry Follows You
walk_away_consequence.text:
The whip echoes in your ears.
You cannot pretend you did not see.

call_guards_consequence.title: They Will Not Help
call_guards_consequence.text:
The guards serve the same masters.
This cry needs another answer.

choices.text: Go closer to the slave yourself

watch_closer.title: He Is My Brother
watch_closer.text:
The Hebrew is bleeding, half-broken.
The taskmaster lifts the whip again.

shout_consequence.title: Too Loud
shout_consequence.text:
Your voice carries far.
Witnesses will remember every word.

bribe_consequence.title: He Laughs at the Gold
bribe_consequence.text:
He pockets it and strikes again.
Gold cannot save your brother.

no_one_sees.title: No One Is Near
no_one_sees.text:
The field is empty. The whip falls.
Your hands clench. Anger rises.

choices.text: Run for help to the palace
choices.feedback: By then he will be dead.

run_palace_consequence.title: Too Late
run_palace_consequence.text:
The palace is far. He will die
before any help arrives. Act now.

strike_egyptian.title: It Is Done
strike_egyptian.text:
One blow. He falls and breathes no more.
The Hebrew flees in silence.

choices.text: Hide his body in the sand
choices.feedback: You bury what you have done.

choices.text: Boast of it in the city

leave_body_consequence.title: He Will Be Found
leave_body_consequence.text:
A body in open sand will speak.
Cover what you have done.

boast_consequence.title: Words Travel
boast_consequence.text:
Pride could undo everything.
First — hide what you have done.

bury_body.title: Buried in the Sand
bury_body.text:
You cover him quickly. No one saw.
You hope no one ever knows.

tell_elders_consequence.title: Whispers Travel
tell_elders_consequence.text:
The elders gasp. Word will spread
faster than you can follow.

return_palace.title: A Long Night
return_palace.text:
The palace lamps burn low.
You sleep little. Tomorrow you must look.

hide_chamber_consequence.title: Silence Is No Shield
hide_chamber_consequence.text:
Hiding cannot undo what is done.
Go see your people.

second_day.title: The Next Day
second_day.text:
Two Hebrews quarrel and shove.
One strikes the other in the dust.

choices.text: Take a side and strike one
choices.feedback: More blood is not the answer.

take_side_consequence.title: Not With Your Hand
take_side_consequence.text:
Yesterday's blow already haunts you.
Use words today, not fists.

ignore_consequence.title: Brothers Wound Brothers
ignore_consequence.text:
If you say nothing, who will?
Speak to them.

rebuke_them.title: "Why Strike Your Brother?"
rebuke_them.text:
The man sneers, eyes narrow.
"Will you kill me as you killed him?"

deny_consequence.title: Lies Will Not Save You
deny_consequence.text:
His eyes already know the truth.
Your secret has slipped away.

threaten_consequence.title: Threats Make Witnesses
threaten_consequence.text:
He will tell others, afraid or angry.
Your secret is undone.

exposed.title: The Thing Is Known
exposed.text:
If a Hebrew knows, Pharaoh will know.
Guards will come for you.

beg_pharaoh_consequence.title: He Will Not Forgive
beg_pharaoh_consequence.text:
An Egyptian was killed by your hand.
Mercy will not save you. Flee.

hide_hebrews_consequence.title: No Shelter Here
hide_hebrews_consequence.text:
They fear Pharaoh more than they trust you.
Flight is the only way.

pharaoh_hears.title: Pharaoh Hears
pharaoh_hears.text:
His voice fills the throne hall.
"Find Moses. Bring me his life."

river_consequence.title: The River Is Watched
river_consequence.text:
Every boat is searched at dawn.
The desert is the only road.

revolt_consequence.title: Not Your Hour
revolt_consequence.text:
The people are not ready.
Flight, not war, is your road today.

leave_egypt.title: Out of Egypt
leave_egypt.text:
The gate closes behind you.
Dust and silence open ahead.

choices.feedback: Each step is freedom and exile.

choices.text: Wait near the gate till dark

wait_gate_consequence.title: Patrols Are Coming
wait_gate_consequence.text:
Lingering here is your death.
Take the desert road now.

desert_walk.title: Endless Sand
desert_walk.text:
Days pass. Sun and wind.
You are alone with your thoughts.

surrender_consequence.title: There Is No Going Back
surrender_consequence.text:
Pharaoh's blade waits in Egypt.
Keep walking east.

curse_consequence.title: Quiet Your Heart
curse_consequence.text:
Anger will not give you water.
Walk. Trust. Breathe.

canyon_pause.title: A Quiet Canyon
canyon_pause.text:
You rest in cool shadow.
Far from palace and chains.

give_up_consequence.title: Rise, Moses
give_up_consequence.text:
Sleep here is sleep forever.
Stand. Walk. Live.

see_well.title: A Well in the Sand
see_well.text:
Palms rise above the dust.
You have come to the land of Midian.

choices.text: Sit and rest by the well
choices.feedback: A stranger in a strange land.

hide_well_consequence.title: You Need Water
hide_well_consequence.text:
Hiding will not slake your thirst.
Go. Sit. Drink.

choices.text: Sit and rest by the well

meet_midianite.title: A Kind Voice
meet_midianite.text:
A young woman offers you water.
"You are welcome here, stranger."

choices.feedback: Pride is not your friend now.

refuse_consequence.title: Receive the Gift
refuse_consequence.text:
Kindness is given to be received.
Drink and stay.

lie_consequence.title: Begin in Truth
lie_consequence.text:
A new life cannot rest on lies.
Receive the water in honesty.

ending.title: A Stranger in Midian
ending.text:
Egypt is behind you. The wilderness holds you.
God is not yet done with Moses.
